summary_1line: After Matanga receives alternative boons from Indra, Yudhishthira asks Bhishma how King Vitahavya once attained Brahmana status, leading into a war-filled backstory.

image_candidates.scene_text: The emaciated ascetic Matanga stands on his toes in harsh penance as Indra descends and catches him while he collapses from exhaustion.
Prince Pratarddana, shining in armor on his chariot, cuts down the sons of Vitahavya as severed heads fall like red Kinsuka blossoms.
The defeated king Vitahavya flees his ruined city and seeks refuge in the quiet forest hermitage of the sage Bhrigu.
